name: pl_match_details
description: Fetch detailed match events and lineups for a given matchId from the Pulselive Premier League API via direct navigation to the events and lineups endpoints.

operations.js: (() => { try { const text = document.body && document.body.innerText ? document.body.innerText : null; if (!text) { return { ok: false, error: 'No body text for events' }; } const parsed = JSON.parse(text); return parsed; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: String(e) }; } })();
